subject: Onboarding form: NovaPay vendor setup — provisional PO and SKU mapping
messages:
From: Laura Kim <laura.kim@novapay.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: NovaPay onboarding form submission / initial SKU list

Hi Monica,

Thanks for the quick onboarding window — attaching our completed vendor intake form and the pricing matrix. A few notes up front: we have three SKUs (PAY-TXN, PAY-SETTLE, PAY-REPORT) and pricing is tiered by monthly volume; the top-level contact for billing is billing@novapay.com.

Can you confirm how Redwood issues provisional PO numbers for new vendors, and whether we can request a temporary spend cap while integrations are validated? We have an initial implementation budget of $45k for the pilot month.

Attachments: NovaPay_Onboard_Form.pdf (application), NovaPay_pricing_sheet.xlsx (sku/pricing)

Thanks,
Laura Kim
Vendor Success | NovaPay
laura.kim@novapay.com

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: procure-team@redwood.com; Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Laura Kim <laura.kim@novapay.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Jun 2025 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: NovaPay onboarding form submission / initial SKU list

Laura — thanks for the materials, received and reviewed. Quick internal notes and asks so we can progress to a provisional PO.

1) We need procurement to issue a provisional PO number that can be used for initial billing while tax and W-9 are being validated.
2) Finance needs a spend cap set for the pilot. Laura requested $45k — is that ok as a temporary cap with monitoring?
3) The pricing sheet lists three SKUs but the item codes in our system have slightly different naming conventions. Marcus / Olga — can one of you take ownership of the SKU mapping and confirm the exact line items Redwood will display to billing? We need a firm mapping before the PO is finalized to avoid line-item reconciliation later.

Laura — I'll scope the provisional PO and loop Finance once Marcus confirms SKU mapping. Expect an update by Monday.

Cheers,
Monica Patel
VP, Procurement | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Laura Kim <laura.kim@novapay.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Jun 2025 11:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: NovaPay onboarding form submission / initial SKU list

Monica / Laura — took a pass on the sheet this morning. Notes below and a proposed mapping. I've also attached a one-page mapping spreadsheet for Finance.

- PAY-TXN -> RW-PAY-TRANSACTIONS (unit: transaction)
- PAY-SETTLE -> RW-PAY-SETTLEMENT (unit: batch)
- PAY-REPORT -> RW-PAY-REPORTING (unit: report/month)

Two minor corrections needed from NovaPay: the pricing sheet lists "PAY-REPORT" as a per-report rate but in implementation it's billed per reporting bundle. Laura — can you confirm the bundle definition (number of reports per bundle)?

If confirmed, procurement can proceed to issue provisional PO with the mapped line items. For the spend cap: Finance indicated provisional caps are fine up to $50k for pilots with weekly spend telemetry. Monica — please confirm whether to set the cap at the requested $45k or at the $50k ceiling.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Procurement Operations | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com

> >

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Laura Kim <laura.kim@novapay.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, finance@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 10 Jun 2025 15:43:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: NovaPay onboarding form submission / initial SKU list — provisional PO issued

Laura — good to go. Summary and next steps below.

Summary decisions:
- Provisional PO number: PO-2025-06-7893 (provisional, will be finalized after W-9 and tax validation).
- Temporary spend cap: $45,000 for pilot month (as requested). Finance will monitor and notify both teams if utilization reaches 80% of cap.
- SKU/line items (as mapped by Marcus):
  * RW-PAY-TRANSACTIONS — maps to PAY-TXN (unit: transaction)
  * RW-PAY-SETTLEMENT — maps to PAY-SETTLE (unit: batch)
  * RW-PAY-REPORTING — maps to PAY-REPORT (billing per reporting bundle)

Line-item correction required: the pricing_sheet.xlsx listed PAY-REPORT as "per-report"; we've set billing to per-bundle. Laura — please resend a one-line clarification that defines bundle size so billing can match NovaPay's invoices to PO line items.

Attachments & links: 
- Attached: PO stub (PO-2025-06-7893_stub.pdf) — use this for initial invoices.
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/8472
- Procurement guidelines: https://redwood-drive.internal/docs/procurement/ponum-guidelines.pdf

Action items:
- Laura: confirm reporting bundle definition (reply to this thread) — then we finalize PO line description.
- Marcus / Olga: queue the mapping in the billing system and tag the vendor record with PO-2025-06-7893.
- Finance: enable weekly spend telemetry for this vendor and set alert at 80% of $45k.

Thanks everyone — welcome aboard, Laura. If you need a faster escalation path for early usage overage, reply with expected ramp dates and we'll provision a short-term override.

Best,
Monica Patel
VP, Procurement | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com
